claim.statement: GitLab's 18.8 release page presents the Developer (Issue to Merge Request) Flow as part of the generally available Duo Agent Platform and describes it as automating a ready issue into a structured merge request.

source.title: What's new in GitLab 18.8
source.locator: GitLab 18.8 release date and Developer (Issue to Merge Request) Flow feature entry

values: model not identified by this release entry

limitations: The release page is a product milestone, not a receipt for an exact flow execution or effective configuration.
Later Developer Flow capabilities and invocation paths must not be projected into 18.8 from this short release description.
unknowns: The exact 18.8 flow definition, runner executor, model and approval behavior are unknown.
The patch release and service revision used by any particular organization are unknown.
